documentTemplates.title: Document Templates
documentTemplates.emptyDescription: Add a reusable document requirement (e.g. Payslip) that loan products can select.
documentTemplates.deleteDescription: This permanently removes the document template and cannot be undone.

feeSchemes.title: Fee Schemes
feeSchemes.emptyDescription: Add a reusable fee scheme (a bundle of fee line items) that loan products can select.
feeSchemes.deleteDescription: This permanently removes the fee scheme and cannot be undone.

interestSchemes.title: Interest Schemes
interestSchemes.emptyDescription: Add a reusable interest scheme (e.g. Standard Reducing Balance) that loan products can select.
interestSchemes.deleteDescription: This permanently removes the interest scheme and cannot be undone.

loanProducts.title: Loan Products
loanProducts.emptyDescriptionFiltered: Try a different search term or status filter.
loanProducts.emptyDescription: Define a loan product's amount range, term range and eligibility window.
loanProducts.deleteDescription: This permanently removes {name} and cannot be undone.

ruleTemplates.title: Rule Templates
ruleTemplates.emptyDescription: Add a reusable eligibility rule (e.g. Min Credit Score 650) that loan products can select.
ruleTemplates.deleteDescription: This permanently removes the rule template and cannot be undone.
ruleTemplates.valueHint: Lower bound for BETWEEN, comma-separated list for IN
ruleTemplates.value2Hint: Upper bound — required only when operator is BETWEEN

termTemplates.title: Term Templates
termTemplates.emptyDescription: Add a reusable term (e.g. 12 months) that loan products can select.
termTemplates.deleteDescription: This permanently removes the term template and cannot be undone.

loanProductDocuments.title: Loan Product Documents
loanProductDocuments.emptyDescription: Assign a reusable document template to a loan product's checklist.
loanProductDocuments.removeDescription: This removes the document from the loan product's checklist. This action cannot be undone.

loanProductFeeSchemes.title: Loan Product Fee Schemes
loanProductFeeSchemes.emptyDescription: Assign a reusable fee scheme to a loan product, with a priority and validity window.
loanProductFeeSchemes.removeDescription: This removes the fee scheme from the loan product. This action cannot be undone.

loanProductInterestSchemes.title: Loan Product Interest Schemes
loanProductInterestSchemes.emptyDescription: Assign a reusable interest scheme to a loan product, with a priority and validity window.
loanProductInterestSchemes.removeDescription: This removes the interest scheme from the loan product. This action cannot be undone.

loanProductRules.title: Loan Product Rules
loanProductRules.emptyDescription: Assign a reusable eligibility rule to a loan product.
loanProductRules.removeDescription: This removes the eligibility rule from the loan product. This action cannot be undone.

loanProductTerms.title: Loan Product Terms
loanProductTerms.emptyDescription: Assign a reusable term template to a loan product.
loanProductTerms.removeDescription: This removes the term from the loan product. This action cannot be undone.
